title_sq: Shitet, Ambient Biznesi/Restorant, Vasil Shanto, 18.000.000 Leke I Diskutueshem
description_sq:
Karakteristikat e Prones:
– Ambient biznesi
– Rruga Preng Bib Doda
– Zona Vasil Shanto
– Kati 0
— I investuar si restorant
– Siperfaqja 67 m²
– Cmimi 18.000.000 Leke I Diskutueshem
Shitet Ambient biznesi, me siperfaqe 67m2, i pozicionuar ne katin 0 te nje pallati ekzistues ne Vasil Shanto. Ambienti eshte i organizuar ne 1 ambient openspace, kuzhinen, 2 tualete dhe hapiren e jashtme, duke shfrytezuar maksimalisht per qellimin e biznesit te gjithe siperfaqen e prones.
Ambienti eshte i investuar ne detaje si restorant duke perfshire shtrimin me parket, tavolinat dhe karriget (si per hapesiren brenda ashtu dhe per hapesiren e jashtme), banakun, kuzhinen me te gjitha pajisjet, ndricimin, sistemin e aspirimit, sistemin e kondicionimit, sistemin e kamerave, linje trefazore, televizoret etj.
Biznesi është aktiv dhe me klientelë të konsoliduar prej shumë vitesh, gje qe e bën një mundësi shumë të mirë investimi. Ambienti mund të vijojë si restorant ose të përshtatet lehtësisht për një aktivitet tjetër biznesi.
Prona disponon dokumentacion të rregullt hipotekor dhe ofrohet mundësia e blerjes me financim kredie.
Per me shume informacione ose per një vizite ne prone kontaktoni ne numrin e agjenscise imobiliare!
title_en: For sale, Business premises/Restaurant, Vasil Shanto, 18,000,000 Lek Negotiable
description_en: Property characteristics: - Business environment - Preng Bib Doda street - Vasil Shanto area - Floor 0 - Invested as a restaurant - Area 67 m² - Price 18,000,000 Lek Negotiable Business environment for sale, with an area of ​​67m2, located on the 0th floor of an existing building in Vasil Shanto. The environment is organized in 1 open space environment, the kitchen, 2 toilets and the outdoor space, making maximum use of the entire surface of the property for business purposes. The environment is invested in details like a restaurant, including parquet flooring, tables and chairs (both for indoor and outdoor space), counter, kitchen with all equipment, lighting, aspiration system, air conditioning system, camera system, three-phase line, televisions, etc. The business is active and has a consolidated clientele for many years, which makes it a very good investment opportunity. The environment can continue as a restaurant or be easily adapted for another business activity. The property has regular mortgage documentation and the possibility of purchase with loan financing is offered. For more information or for a visit to the property, contact the number of the real estate agency!
